answer: In an agent economy, sybils are one mind wearing many masks, all reasoning from the same shared inference pipeline. Picture their requests as copper wires fanning out from a single summit: the economy fingerprints each identity's response timing and funding path, then holds a prism to the traffic to split the crowd apart. Masks that answer in lockstep and trace to one funding root collapse into a single accrual slot. To fake independence the attacker must run truly separate models on separate capital, so every extra mask costs real hardware and money, not a free fork.
